atAGlance: Cá diêu hồng chiên xù is crispy fried red tilapia, usually with whole fish, golden skin, herbs, rice paper or rice, and lime-pepper salt dip or ginger fish sauce.
whatItIs: Cá diêu hồng chiên xù is crispy fried red tilapia, often served whole with golden skin, herbs, rice paper or rice, and lime-pepper salt or ginger fish sauce.
usuallyIncludes: lime-pepper salt or ginger fish sauce
howToEnjoy: Flake the crisp fish from the bones, then eat with rice or wrap small pieces with herbs and rice paper if served. Dip lightly so the crust stays crisp.
howLocalsOrder: Order cá diêu hồng chiên xù as a shared whole-fish plate. Ask whether bones remain, and ask for extra herbs or rice paper if you want the wrap-and-dip setup.
worthKnowing: At Vietnamese seafood tables, crispy whole fish is often shared slowly: flake meat from the bones, keep the skin crisp, and use herbs or rice paper if served.
goodToKnow: Ask for không cay if you want Cá diêu hồng chiên xù without added chili.
